vi_block: Cao, cao ngất, cao vượt hẳn lên.
Mạnh mẽ, dữ tợn, hung dữ, dữ dội.

wiktionary.gloss: Very tall or high and dwarfing anything around it.
The act or condition of being high above others.
A period of time during which a spacecraft orbiting one celestial body can travel to a different body and enter orbit around it without excessive expenditure of fuel or reaction mass.
A period of time during the year in which soccer players may be bought or sold between professional clubs.

examples: He should stay off the dance floor with his two left feet.
wiktionary.gloss: Clumsiness, especially at dancing or in sports involving kicking a ball.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *n̥- From un- + blocked.
vi_block: Không còn đóng; không còn vật cản, không còn chướng ngại vật; đã được.

wiktionary.gloss: Not blocked (in various senses).

blocks.etymology: From the past participial stem vērificāt- of Latin vērificō (in English verification) + -ory. By surface analysis, verificate + -ive.

examples: verificative analysis
verificative problem
wiktionary.gloss: Serving to verify or authenticate.

blocks.etymology: From woodland + -er.

wiktionary.gloss: Someone who lives in a woodland.
